summary: Converge synchronous volley kill accounting into TurretCombatService, migrate TurretDefinition construction to a named builder without value drift, delete the dead solar cycle path, and drive special launch sounds from definition metadata, with zero gameplay, persistence or network changes.

authoritative_state: Kill and player-kill counters remain owned by TurretBaseBlockEntity and are mutated only through recordKill.
A single synchronous volley that kills its target increments the kill counter exactly once, regardless of shot executions.
Asynchronous projectile kills remain recorded by TurretProjectileEntity through its source base.
TurretDefinition default values are immutable constants; config getters keep delegating to ModServerConfig.

fields: Base save/load keys remain unchanged (kills, player_kills, shots_fired included).
No persistence schema field is added, removed or re-typed by this feature.

flows.purpose: Preserve existing per-shot turret aim visual updates; this feature introduces no new payloads and no schema changes.
validation: Payload type and field order stay unchanged.
Only bounded presentation state is sent to clients.

client_boundary.dedicated_server_fallback: All touched classes are common/server only; combat accounting executes on the server thread and never loads client-only classes.

budgets.scope: Existing ArchitecturePressureGameTests fixture (100 bases / heads / targets) executed by the standard L4 gate
budgets.measurement: The pre-existing pressure fixture records per-tick server timings after warmup; the candidate run must stay within the fixture's own asserted bound, proving the accounting convergence added no measurable hot-path cost.

hot_paths: TurretCombatService volley dispatch and kill accounting
performance.measurement_environment: Behavioral equivalence asserted by GameTests; pressure non-regression covered by the existing fixture inside the normal L4 run.

mods.fallback: The mod refuses to load outside the pinned NeoForge 21.1 line.

criteria.statement: Synchronous volley kills are recorded in exactly one place: TurretCombatService after the execution loop. BeamVolleyStrategy no longer records kills and TurretHeadBlockEntity no longer branches on ShotKind for accounting.
criteria.observation: New combat kill accounting GameTest passes; existing combat regression tests stay green.

criteria.statement: Asynchronous projectile kills still increment base kill counters exactly once via TurretProjectileEntity.
criteria.observation: Existing projectile combat GameTests pass unchanged.

criteria.statement: After builder migration every TurretDefinition exposes byte-identical default gameplay values for all eleven turret types.
criteria.observation: Golden defaults GameTest compares all definitions against an explicit expected-value table.

criteria.statement: BaseAddonEngine.runSolarCycle is removed; RELATIVISTIC and TELEPORTER launch sound volume/pitch come from definition metadata instead of enum identity checks in TurretHeadBlockEntity.
criteria.observation: Static gate finds no runSolarCycle references; special sound metadata GameTest asserts fixed launch sound parameters for both turret types.

criteria.statement: Persistence keys and versions remain unchanged and round-trip without loss.

steps: Open TurretDefinition.ShotKind and confirm the Javadoc documents it as the presentation-layer taxonomy (rendering/sound) while VolleyStrategy remains the behavioral taxonomy.
Confirm no code path outside TurretCombatService, TurretProjectileEntity and TurretBaseBlockEntity.recordKill mutates kill counters.

non_goals: No gameplay balance changes: damage, range, energy costs and fire intervals keep their exact current values.
No persistence schema changes: save keys and data versions stay as shipped.
No network payload changes: protocol version and payload schemas stay untouched.
No registry identity changes: blocks, items, entities and sound events keep their IDs.
No merging of ShotKind into VolleyStrategy: this batch only documents the boundary.
